purpose: Calculate the average diffusion distance x of solute C in an α-Fe (Fe) matrix in time t, used to determine the heat-treatment conditions for recovering only the Cottrell atmosphere.
applicability_conditions: Applied to the diffusion of solute C in an α-Fe matrix at room-temperature-relevant conditions; in this study used to calculate the heat treatment condition of 373 K for 90 h for recovering only the Cottrell atmosphere due to C diffusion while keeping dislocations stationary.

symbols.meaning: Average diffusion distance of solute C in the α-Fe matrix (also referred to as x in the text)

unmapped: Heat treatment condition: 373 K for 90 h
The workpieces were treated after the tensile test to recover only the Cottrell atmosphere due to C diffusion while keeping dislocations stationary
The equation is an Einstein-type relation (X = (2Dt)^(1/2)) for average diffusion distance
